episodes.synopsis: An ordinary elementary school student, Yuta Akigawa was suddenly taken into the Web World through his cell phone. At that moment, he was met by the Web Ghosts.
episodes.title: Welcome @ Net World

episodes.synopsis: Yuta who was suddenly drawn into the Web World was invited by PiPoPa to wander around this world. When he first looked around at the scenes, he was astonished. However, no one knew how Yuta could return to his world…
episodes.title: Want to Go Home @ Can't Go Home

episodes.synopsis: Today is Taro’s first day at the new school he transferred to but it’s such a high tech elementary school that he is totally bewildered by everything. Moreover, PiPoPa from the Web World are visiting his school’s website.
episodes.title: Let's Go To School!

episodes.synopsis: Hikaru, who is interested in Yuta, invited him to her house. However, Hikaru’s grandfather is hard to please. He has a PhD...
episodes.title: Hikaru, Pudding, Grandfather

episodes.synopsis: PiPoPa’s eternal Web Ghosts rivals are BiBoBa. Today, they challenged PiPoPa to competitions. Yuta is also being challenged to competitions by his classmate Kazushige.
episodes.title: BiBoBa @ Appear!

episodes.synopsis: Recently, Yuta and PiPoPa have slipped into the Net TV which has been the topic of conversation. They have gone around visiting various channels. However, a dreadful computer virus suddenly attacked!
episodes.title: Channel Wars

episodes.synopsis: Recently the classmate, Karin, has been depressed. Her family business of running an inn hasn’t had many customers and it seems they will go out of business. Yuta and Hikaru wanted to make a homepage for the inn to help market it but for some reason, Karin’s grandmother doesn’t like the internet...
episodes.title: Inn @ Yukitani's

episodes.synopsis: In order to study about the societal structure, Yuta will be visiting Dream Future. However, he goes astray at the company and ends up in the basement. What does he see there?
episodes.title: Yuta @ Company Visit

episodes.synopsis: A young part-time worker, Aizawa, turned up in Kamimai city. However, Yuta and Hikaru are worried since Aizawa is quite clumsy. At that time, a suspicious event occurred in the shopping district. Who could it be?
episodes.title: Go and Work @ Aizawa

episodes.synopsis: Today is Yuta’s birthday. Last year, he was able to celebrate with his good friend, Mamoru. Yuta asks PiPoPa if they can help him meet Mamoru through the Web World.
episodes.title: Mamoru and Yuta

episodes.synopsis: Yuta is busy playing games with his friends when they hatch a secret plan.

episodes.synopsis: Dream Future staff member Mr. Kazama is busy working on a mysterious new project... The Siren Project.

episodes.synopsis: Hikaru follows Yuta into the closet where he suddenly disappears...

episodes.synopsis: Hikaru shows off her talent against Kazushige in a fighting game, beating him five times in a row!

episodes.synopsis: Seeking inspiration, Mamoru reminisces about a time when he and Yuta were looking up at the stars
